purpose: Accept valid student assignments for coordinator, co-coordinator, and replacement leaders.
preconditions: A club creation or leadership change is available; the selected coordinator, co-coordinator, and replacement leader are valid students.
action_or_input: Create a club or change its leadership using valid student assignments.
expected_result: The operation accepts the student leadership assignments.

purpose: Reject an invalid student leadership assignment.
preconditions: A club creation or leadership change is available; at least one selected leader is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the operation with the invalid student assignment.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Accept a valid faculty member as Club Faculty Councillor.
preconditions: A faculty councillor can be assigned; the selected person is a valid faculty member.
action_or_input: Assign or use the valid faculty member as Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The assignment or use is accepted.

purpose: Reject an invalid faculty councillor.
preconditions: A faculty councillor can be assigned or used; the selected person is not a valid faculty member.
action_or_input: Assign or use the invalid faculty member as Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Accept each allowed club category.
preconditions: Club creation is available.
action_or_input: Submit club creation using each of Technical, Sports, and Cultural as the category.
expected_result: Each club category value is accepted.

purpose: Reject a category outside the allowed values.
preconditions: Club creation is available.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with a category other than Technical, Sports, or Cultural.

purpose: Verify that a newly created club starts open.
preconditions: A Student Admin can create a club with valid required assignments.
action_or_input: Create a new club.
expected_result: The created club has open status.

purpose: Verify that Student Admin approval confirms an open club.
preconditions: An open club exists and the actor is Student Admin.
action_or_input: Approve the open club.
expected_result: The club status changes to confirmed.

purpose: Accept a booking whose start time is earlier than its end time.
preconditions: A session or event can be booked at a configured venue and there is no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: Submit a booking with start time earlier than end time.

purpose: Reject a booking whose start time is not earlier than its end time.
preconditions: A session or event booking is available.
action_or_input: Submit a booking with start time equal to or later than end time.

purpose: Accept a booking that does not overlap another booking in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: An existing session or event is booked at a venue on a date; the proposed booking uses that venue and date but does not overlap its time window.
action_or_input: Submit the non-overlapping session or event booking.

purpose: Prevent overlapping sessions in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: A session exists at a venue on a date.
action_or_input: Submit another session at the same venue and date with an overlapping time window.

purpose: Prevent overlapping events in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: An event exists at a venue on a date.
action_or_input: Submit another event at the same venue and date with an overlapping time window.

purpose: Prevent an event from overlapping a session in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: A session exists at a venue on a date.
action_or_input: Submit an event at the same venue and date with an overlapping time window.

purpose: Prevent a session from overlapping an event in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: An event exists at a venue on a date.
action_or_input: Submit a session at the same venue and date with an overlapping time window.

purpose: Allow a student to apply to a confirmed club.
preconditions: The club is confirmed and the student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the confirmed club.

purpose: Prevent a student from applying to a club that is not confirmed.
preconditions: The club is open.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the open club.

purpose: Allow applications to different clubs.
preconditions: A student has an application or membership in one club; another club is confirmed and the student has no application to it.
action_or_input: Apply to the other confirmed club.
expected_result: The application is not blocked solely because of the student's application or membership in the first club.

purpose: Reject a duplicate application to the same club without changing membership state.
preconditions: A student already has an application to a confirmed club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to that same club.
expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and the existing membership state remains unchanged.

purpose: Authorize the club coordinator to perform Club Head operations for that club.
preconditions: The actor is the coordinator of the club.
action_or_input: Invoke a Club Head operation for that club.

purpose: Authorize the club co-coordinator to perform Club Head operations for that club.
preconditions: The actor is the co-coordinator of the club.
action_or_input: Invoke a Club Head operation for that club.

purpose: Deny Club Head operations to a person who is neither coordinator nor co-coordinator of that club.
preconditions: The actor is not the coordinator or co-coordinator of the club.
action_or_input: Invoke a Club Head operation for that club.

purpose: Confirm a pending membership application and retain optional remarks when supplied.
preconditions: A pending application has open status; the actor is an applicable Club Head.
action_or_input: Approve the application and supply optional remarks.
expected_result: The application status changes from open to confirmed and the remarks are retained.

purpose: Confirm a pending membership application when optional remarks are omitted.
preconditions: A pending application has open status; the actor is an applicable Club Head.
action_or_input: Approve the application without remarks.
expected_result: The application status changes from open to confirmed.

purpose: Accept a poll with at least two choices.
preconditions: A Club Head can create a poll.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with two choices.

purpose: Reject a poll with fewer than two choices.
preconditions: A Club Head can create a poll.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with fewer than two choices.

source_id: BR-GYM-013 selected batch and branch targeting
purpose: Route poll notification and access according to selected batch and branch groups.
preconditions: A Club Head can create a poll and student groups can be selected by batch and branch.
action_or_input: Create a poll targeting selected batch and branch groups, then evaluate notification and access for students in and outside those groups.
expected_result: The selected groups determine the intended notification recipients and poll access audience; students outside the target audience are not treated as intended recipients or eligible for access.

purpose: Support a branch selection representing all branches where that option is supported.
preconditions: Poll creation supports a branch selection representing all branches.
action_or_input: Create a poll selecting the all-branches option for a batch.
expected_result: The poll audience includes the selected batch across all branches.

purpose: Allow an eligible student to access or vote in an active, unexpired poll.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired; the student belongs to its selected target audience.
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.
expected_result: Participation is allowed, subject to the one-vote-per-poll constraint.

purpose: Prevent participation in an inactive poll.
preconditions: The poll is inactive and the student belongs to its selected target audience.
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.

purpose: Prevent participation in an expired poll.
preconditions: The poll is expired and the student belongs to its selected target audience.
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.

purpose: Prevent participation by a student outside the selected target audience.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired; the student does not belong to its selected target audience.
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.

purpose: Allow a student to cast a vote in a poll.
preconditions: The student is eligible for an active, unexpired poll and has not voted in it.
action_or_input: Submit one vote in the poll.

purpose: Reject a second vote by the same student in the same poll.
preconditions: The student has already voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Submit another vote in the same poll.

purpose: Ensure superseded active leadership assignments no longer remain current after a leadership change.
preconditions: A club has current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments; valid replacement leaders are available.
action_or_input: Change the coordinator or co-coordinator assignment.
expected_result: The new leaders are recorded as current and superseded current designations are retired or removed.

purpose: Accept a club budget request with an amount of zero.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head and the required supporting file is included.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with amount zero.
expected_result: The amount passes the non-negative amount rule.

purpose: Accept a club budget request with a positive amount.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head and the required supporting file is included.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with an amount greater than zero.
expected_result: The amount passes the non-negative amount rule.

purpose: Reject a club budget request with a negative amount.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head and the required supporting file is included.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with an amount less than zero.

purpose: Accept a budget request that includes its required supporting file.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head and the budget amount is non-negative.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request passes the supporting-file rule.

purpose: Reject a budget request missing its required supporting file.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head and the budget amount is non-negative.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request without the required supporting file.

purpose: Accept an event report that includes its report/details file.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head.
action_or_input: Submit an event report with the required report/details file.
expected_result: The report passes the required-file rule.

purpose: Reject an event report missing its report/details file.
preconditions: The actor is an applicable Club Head.
action_or_input: Submit an event report without the required report/details file.

purpose: Accept a booking at a venue configured for Gymkhana booking.
preconditions: A session or event can be booked; the selected venue is configured for Gymkhana booking and has no conflicting booking.
action_or_input: Submit the booking using the configured venue.
expected_result: The venue passes the configured-venue rule.

purpose: Reject a booking at a venue not configured for Gymkhana booking.
preconditions: A session or event booking is available; the selected venue is not configured for Gymkhana booking.
action_or_input: Submit the booking using the unconfigured venue.

purpose: Allow the assigned Club Faculty Councillor to review or access submitted reports for the assigned club.
preconditions: A report has been submitted for a club; the authenticated faculty member is that club's assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
action_or_input: Open the submitted report for review.
expected_result: Access to the report is allowed.

purpose: Deny report review or access when the authenticated faculty member is not the assigned councillor for the report's club.
preconditions: A report has been submitted for a club; the authenticated faculty member is not that club's assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
action_or_input: Open the submitted report for review.
